g.text: Measured condition values · 10 matched chain pairs · 4 roles per chain · 24 game weeks
Calculation: For each role, calculate sample variance of its 24 weekly orders: sum of squared deviations from that role's mean divided by
23. Average the 4 role variances, then average 10 chains.
Fictional student time framing; actual model runtime was unrestricted. Values are observed levels, not differences.
